entries.worklist_string: While active, move into adjacent robots to assimilate and convert them to Borg form. Starting the process is a
entries.raw_template: While active, move into adjacent robots to assimilate and convert them to Borg form. Starting the process is a {n}-turn action, unaffected by any melee attack time modifiers. Higher-rated targets are harder to assimilate, and the conversion takes longer, but always at least {n} turns. The matter cost to assimilate increases significantly with the current number of Borg allies. Borg regenerate both core and parts at a rate that also increases with the number of Borg allies. Similarly, {n} regenerates itself over time via the same principle. Losing a Borg ally causes core damage to self, the amount dependent on robot tier. If insufficient remaining core, {n} is destroyed instead. Removing or otherwise losing this part causes all Borg allies to form their own collective.

The matter cost to assimilate increases significantly with the current number of Borg allies. Borg regenerate both core and parts at a rate that also increases with the number of Borg allies. Similarly, {n} regenerates itself over time via the same principle. Losing a Borg ally causes core damage to self, the amount dependent on robot tier. If insufficient remaining core, {n} is destroyed instead. Removing or otherwise losing this part causes all Borg allies to form their own collective.
entries.translation: 启用时，移入相邻机器人即可同化并将其转化为博格形态。启动需耗时{n}回合，不受近战攻击时间修正影响。目标等级越高越难同化，转化耗时也越长，但至少需要{n}回合。同化的物质消耗会随博格盟友数量大幅增加。博格盟友的核心与部件再生速度也会随数量提升。同理，{n}也会依此原理随时间自我再生。失去一名博格盟友会对自身核心造成伤害，数值取决于机器人等级。若剩余核心完整性不足，则改为摧毁{n}。移除或以其他方式失去此部件后，所有博格盟友将形成各自的集体。
